_comment: Release notes shown in the app ('What's new' pop-up after an update, and Settings > Release notes) and on the GitHub release page. Newest first. EVERY Android release needs an entry here whose version matches the release (1.0.<workflow run number>); the release workflow refuses to publish otherwise. Keep it high level and in plain English.

new: Connecting to your computer is easier: just type its address (like 192.168.1.20:8077) and the app asks before using plain HTTP on your home network.
improved: Clear, plain-English messages when connecting fails (wrong port, firewall, different Wi-Fi, wrong password), instead of technical errors.
The app checks that the address really is a Ratchet Wrench server before signing in, and ignores anything pasted after the port.
If the first sync after signing in hits a problem, you're still signed in and it retries automatically.
fixed: “Unable to parse TLS packet header” when connecting to the desktop app or Docker server.
One photo the server couldn't accept no longer stops the whole sync.

new: Release notes: after each update, a “What's new” message shows what changed the first time you open the app.
Settings now has a Release notes section listing what changed in every version.
The VIN scanner also reads the printed VIN, not just the barcode. You confirm a VIN read from text before it's used.
Flashlight button, zoom slider and tap-to-focus on the VIN scanner.
improved: Much better barcode reading: the scanner now looks at a far sharper picture (1080p instead of 640×480).

new: The camera shows small previews of the photos you've taken.
improved: Photos are saved without hidden location details on the phone's copy.
fixed: Photos no longer disappear when you turn the phone while using the camera or adding an entry.
Photos are no longer sideways or flipped — they're saved and shown the way you took them, even with auto-rotate off.

new: Settings button on the Garage screen, and an About section in Settings.
improved: Every release is now tested by automatically tapping through the app before it's published.
fixed: The app no longer crashes when opened with a vehicle saved, or when adding an entry (icons were missing).
Deleting an entry now always works.

improved: If the app ever closes unexpectedly, it offers to copy the error details next time (kept on your phone only).
fixed: Scan barcode no longer crashes the app.

new: The app updates itself: new versions download on Wi-Fi (or ask first on mobile data) and install after a quick confirmation.
